A_7_1.title: Physical Security Perimeters
A_7_1.description: Areas holding sensitive information or IT, such as server rooms or archives, have defined boundaries that are physically secured.

A_7_2.title: Physical Entry
A_7_2.description: Entry to secured areas is controlled so that only authorised people get in, for example with keys, badges and visitor logs.

A_7_3.title: Securing Offices, Rooms and Facilities
A_7_3.description: Offices, rooms and other facilities get physical protection that matches what is kept or processed in them.

A_7_4.title: Physical Security Monitoring
A_7_4.description: The premises are watched for unauthorised entry, for example with alarms, cameras or a security service.

A_7_5.title: Protecting Against Physical and Environmental Threats
A_7_5.description: Facilities are protected against fire, water, power surges, storms and deliberate damage, according to the risks at the site.

A_7_6.title: Working in Secure Areas
A_7_6.description: Special rules apply to work in secured areas, for example no unaccompanied visitors or no photos.

A_7_7.title: Clear Desk and Clear Screen
A_7_7.description: Desks are cleared of papers and storage media when not in use, and screens lock when people step away.

A_7_8.title: Equipment Siting and Protection
A_7_8.description: Equipment is placed and protected so that heat, water, dust, theft and prying eyes do not harm it.

A_7_9.title: Security of Assets Off-Premises
A_7_9.description: Laptops, phones and other company devices used outside the premises are protected against loss, theft and onlookers.

A_7_10.title: Storage Media
A_7_10.description: USB sticks, disks and other storage media are handled securely from purchase through use and transport to destruction.

A_7_11.title: Supporting Utilities
A_7_11.description: IT is protected against failures of power, cooling and other utilities, for example with an uninterruptible power supply.

A_7_12.title: Cabling Security
A_7_12.description: Power and network cables are laid and protected so that they cannot easily be tapped, disturbed or damaged.

A_7_13.title: Equipment Maintenance
A_7_13.description: Equipment is maintained so that it stays available and reliable, also when outside technicians work on it. Recommendation: follow the manufacturer's service intervals.

A_7_14.title: Secure Disposal or Re-Use of Equipment
A_7_14.description: Before devices are disposed of or reused, the company checks that the data and licensed software on them have been securely removed.
